item.title: Montverde girls score late, add another 3A state soccer title to the pile
item.description: Montverde scored two late second-half goals to break open a scoreless tie, down Fort Lauderdale Cardinal Gibbons 2-0 and capture the Class 3A girls soccer state championship. It was the fifth state title for the program since 2018.

item.title: Virginia, fouled on 3-pointer with 3.6 seconds left, surges by Miami
item.description: Malik Reneau’s layup with 7 seconds left tied the game 83-83. Chance Mallory took the inbounds pass and raced across the half-court line, elevating for a shot attempt and getting fouled.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 22, 2026
item.description: There's no need to be sharp with one another. Fiery Mars leaps into a supportive sextile to healing Chiron, encouraging us to make the first move in mending strained bonds of any type. This is furthered by the affectionate trine between fond Venus and lucky Jupiter at 3:01 pm EST, inviting us to give and receive appreciation in equal measure. Creative solutions could be necessary for any remaining tension, which means we've got permission to have fun with the process of figuring things out.

item.title: Beede’s Breakdown: Magic push Suns to 2 OTs before losing at buzzer
item.description: While the Suns were without Devin Booker, the Magic were missing Jalen Suggs and Franz Wagner on Saturday at Phoenix.

item.title: Orlando City fall flat in first half, drop opener to Red Bulls
item.description: The Lions’ new lineup struggled at times, and New York took advantage of that to earn its first win under new head coach Michael Bradley.

item.title: Fulks’ late foul shots help UCF sink Utah 73-71
item.description: Themus Fulks scored 24 points and made his only two foul shots of the night with three seconds left and UCF beat Utah 73-71 on Saturday night.

item.title: Young Olympia basketball team didn’t blink under pressure | FHSAA Playoffs
item.description: Olympia, with top 8 players underclassmen, is clutch when it counts. "The guys were just ready for the moment," said coach Justin Shipp. No. 1 Lake Highland cruises; Oak Ridge and Windermere play stall-ball; Lake Howell goes double-OT in basketball playoffs.
